mods.name: Ruby Radiance
mods.description: Ruby Radiance is a Minecraft mod that introduces magical ruby-based content, tools, and mystical mechanics to enhance your Minecraft experience. Features Ethernal Rubies, Magic Blocks, Ruby Tools, and more!

releases.notes:
🎉 Initial Release
Welcome to Ruby Radiance - a magical mod that transforms the world of Minecraft with the power of mystical ruby energy! This is the first stable release of our mod, converted and enhanced from the original EmeraldDawn concept.

✨ New Features
🔴 Ethernal Ruby System
Ethernal Ruby: The core magical material obtained by smelting emeralds
Transform regular emeralds into powerful Ethernal Rubies using furnaces or blast furnaces
Used as the primary crafting ingredient for all ruby-based items

⚒️ Ruby Tool Set
Complete set of ruby-powered tools with enhanced durability and mining speed:
Ruby Sword: Powerful melee weapon with ruby energy
Ruby Pickaxe: Efficient mining tool for all your excavation needs
Ruby Axe: Perfect for forestry work with enhanced cutting power
Ruby Shovel: Ideal for earthworks and terrain modification
Ruby Hoe: Essential farming tool with ruby enhancement

🏗️ Ruby Blocks
Ethernal Ruby Block: Decorative and functional storage block crafted from 9 Ethernal Rubies
Magic Block: A mysterious ruby-infused block requiring diamond-level tools to mine
Ruby Ore Variants: Find ruby treasures in the world (textures ready for future ore generation)

🪄 Magical Items
Ruby Wand: A mystical tool crafted with sticks, emeralds, and diamonds for magical manipulation
Ruby Apple: Enhanced sustenance providing powerful regeneration and resistance effects
Blue Berry: Additional consumable with unique properties

🔧 Technical Improvements
Data Generation System
Fully automated recipe, model, and blockstate generation
Proper namespace consistency throughout all assets
Fixed rendering issues for all items and blocks
Recipe System
Smelting Recipes: Convert emeralds to Ethernal Rubies via furnace/blast furnace
Crafting Recipes: Complete crafting trees for all tools, blocks, and magical items
Alternative Recipes: Multiple ways to obtain certain items
Tool Mining System
Proper tool tier implementation with ruby tools requiring iron-level materials to mine
Magic Block requires diamond-level tools, creating interesting progression
Correct block hardness and harvest levels

🛠️ Bug Fixes & Optimizations
✅ Fixed namespace inconsistencies between ruby-radiance and [rubyradiance](vscode-file://vscode-app/c:/Users/Sriram/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html)
✅ Resolved texture rendering issues for all items and blocks
✅ Corrected recipe JSON format errors
✅ Fixed data generation compatibility with Fabric Loom 1.6-SNAPSHOT
✅ Resolved Gradle build issues with proper dependency management
✅ Fixed block tag provider references

📥 Installation
Install [Fabric Loader 0.17.2+](vscode-file://vscode-app/c:/Users/Sriram/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html) for Minecraft 1.21
Download and install [Fabric API 0.102.0+1.21](vscode-file://vscode-app/c:/Users/Sriram/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html)
Download ruby-radiance-1.0.0.jar from the releases page
Place the JAR file in your mods folder
Launch Minecraft and enjoy!
